rules.name: BSDTHREE_Ok
rules.source:

rules.name: ALLOWAPACHE_Pe
rules.source:
/* Breeze built-in detection rules: AllowApache (https://example.invalid/allow-apache/), license Apache-2.0. Copyright 2023 Example Apache Authors. Full licence texts: breeze-yara-builtin-report.json in the Breeze release. */
import "pe"

rule ALLOWAPACHE_Pe : FILE
{
	meta:
		description = "uses the pe module"
		score = 95
		quality = 80
	strings:
		$a = "breeze_fixture_pe"
	condition:
		uint16(0) == 0x5a4d and pe.number_of_sections > 1 and $a
}
